picks.why: true general view of the town with its church towers, a windmill and factory chimneys
broad view down the landscaped square with its villas; better than the street and single-building cards

gaps: P0: nothing; P1–P2: only views of Uerdingen (#1–#3), a separate town until 1929, and a plan (#4); P4: only a street scene (#8) and a portrait-format town hall card (#10); P6: existing aerial of Linn Castle kept
notes: #1 (Kieser, about 1600) and #2–#3 (Jan de Beijer, 1739, Rijksmuseum) are good views of Uerdingen, now part of Krefeld; skipped because Uerdingen was then a different town from Krefeld. Add #3 (general view of Uerdingen on the Rhine) if a district view is acceptable. #13 is Nijmegen, #14 a 1945 evacuation photo, #12 a 1923 photo of the town hall facade.
